# Stakeholder Map

Map stakeholders by influence and interest to determine the right engagement strategy for each.

## Process
1. Identify all stakeholders (internal and external)
2. Assess each on influence (ability to affect outcome) and interest (how much they care)
3. Categorize and define engagement strategy

## Output Format

# Stakeholder Map: [Product/Initiative]

## Stakeholder Grid

### High Influence + High Interest (Manage Closely)
| Stakeholder | Role | Interest | Concern | Engagement |
|------------|------|---------|---------|-----------|
| ... | ... | ... | ... | Regular 1:1s, co-create decisions |

### High Influence + Low Interest (Keep Satisfied)
| Stakeholder | Role | Why low interest | Trigger to engage | Engagement |
|------------|------|-----------------|------------------|-----------|
| ... | ... | ... | ... | Brief updates, escalation path |

### Low Influence + High Interest (Keep Informed)
| Stakeholder | Role | Interest | Value they provide | Engagement |
|------------|------|---------|-------------------|-----------|
| ... | ... | ... | ... | Regular updates, feedback channel |

### Low Influence + Low Interest (Monitor)
| Stakeholder | Role | When to re-assess |
|------------|------|-----------------|
| ... | ... | ... |

## Communication Plan
| Audience | Format | Frequency | Content | Owner |
|----------|--------|-----------|---------|-------|
| ... | ... | ... | ... | ... |
